Shipping & Delivery

Delivery Information

We deliver nationwide across South Africa and ship worldwide. Here's everything you need to know.

Same-Day Delivery

Available in Cape Town metro & select Johannesburg areas. Order before 11am.

Nationwide (1–3 Days)

Door-to-door delivery across all 9 South African provinces via courier.

International Shipping

We ship worldwide. Rates and timelines vary by country. Contact us for a quote.

Secure Packaging

All products are carefully packaged to prevent damage in transit.

Frequently Asked

Is delivery free?

Yes! We offer free delivery on all orders within South Africa and free worldwide shipping. No minimum order required.

How do I track my order?

Once your payment is confirmed, you'll receive a tracking number via email. You can also use our Track Order page.

Can I change my delivery address?

Contact us as soon as possible after placing your order. We can update your address before dispatch.

What if my order arrives damaged?

Contact us immediately via email with photos. We'll arrange a replacement or refund under our returns policy.

Need a delivery quote?

Contact us for international shipping quotes and special delivery arrangements.
